name: synteyes-standin
label: Baseline refraction of the synthetic calibration cohort (stand-in for the SyntEyes mixture)
citation: Rozema JJ, Rodriguez P, Navarro R, Tassignon MJ, SyntEyes: a higher-order statistical eye model for healthy eyes, Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 57(2):683-691, 2016, doi 10.1167/iovs.15-18067 (abstract by search excerpt, 2026-10-29): the corneal shape as Zernike eigenvectors and 18 further biometric parameters of 312 right eyes (40.8 +/- 11.0 years) modeled as a sum of two multivariate Gaussians. The fitted means and covariances are in the paper's supplement, which the cloud session could not reach.
transcriptionNote: Stand-in: one Gaussian component over the clinical power vector (M, J0, J45) of the cohort at its baseline age. The J0 mean and the astigmatic spread are calibration nuisance parameters (data/calibration/priors.json), fitted to the youngest axis-class band, because no excerpt gave a population distribution that reproduces it (adolescents in one excerpt: J0 0.01 +/- 0.11 D, cylinder -0.09 +/- 0.27 D, too little astigmatism for the 63% WTR among astigmatic children of another). Replace with the SyntEyes mixture (its refraction marginal) when the supplement can be transcribed.
componentCitation: assumption: M mean +0.5 D and SD 1.0 D (school-age children are mildly hyperopic on average; no excerpt value), J0 mean +0.15 D and J0/J45 SD 0.25 D (starting values of the nuisance parameters), M independent of J0 and J45 (assumption: independence).
